fieldValues.title: The projected schema describes the fieldValues object
fieldValues.normative_statement: A Type's projected JSON Schema describes the `fieldValues` object, not the whole Record document. `instanceId`, `typeId`, `tags`, `meta`, `sourceRefs`, and `fieldMeta` are envelope members governed by `record.json`, and are outside the projected schema's `additionalProperties: false`. (RFC-039 [R17])
